items.title: Snowman Looking Through a Brass Telescope
items.alt: Snowman in a green fleece-lined earflap hat and orange scarf looking through a brass telescope on a wooden tripod.
items.description: One twig hand steadies the eyepiece while the other rests on the tall tripod beneath the extended brass barrel.

items.title: Snowman Paper Lantern with Handle
items.alt: Round white paper lantern shaped like a snowman, with a red cap, green scarf, twig arms and a curved hanging handle.
items.description: Horizontal paper ribs remain visible across both round sections, with simple black dots forming the eyes, smile and buttons.

items.title: Snowman Peeking from a Ribboned Gift
items.alt: Small snowman with blue earmuffs peeking out of a red gift box tied with a large gold ribbon bow.
items.description: The open box frames the round face and twig hands while the ribbon tails curl away from the front.

items.title: Snowman on Snowshoes Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white outline of a tall snowman in a pom-pom cap and scarf standing on two woven snowshoes.
items.description: Spread twig arms and a trailing fringed scarf balance the long body above the detailed snowshoe webbing.

items.title: Snowman Beside a Birdbath Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white snowman in a knitted cap and scarf reaching toward a small bird on a stone birdbath.
items.description: The plump figure faces the bird across the rounded basin, whose pedestal has a simple cobblestone pattern.

items.title: Snowmen Making a Snowflake Puzzle Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white drawing of two snowmen assembling a large snowflake-shaped puzzle on a round wooden table.
items.description: The tall character lifts one loose piece while the shorter earmuff-wearing companion reaches across the tabletop.
